event_name: Date 29 April 2018 Time 17:36 2018 AZERBAIJAN GRAND PRIX 26 - 29 April 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 11 overtaking before the safety car line.
incident_time: Penalty (2 penalty points awarded, 5 points in total for the 12 month period)
offence: Breach of Article 39.8 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards examined video and car positioning evidence. This showed that car 11 overtook car 18 before reaching the safety car line. The Stewards noted that Car 11 was heading into the pits at the time. Garry Connelly Dennis Dean Tom Kristensen Anar Shukurov
rules_referenced: Article 39.8 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
